status: Native configured measurement-tone component qualified; public API and desktop integration incomplete

contract.private_command: 11-byte Q + BE64 nonzero monotonically increasing nonce + BE16 integer spacing_hz; existing9-byte response echoes nonce and result.
contract.tones: 1305 minus/plus spacing/2 Hz relative to waveform carrier; odd integer spacing gives half-hertz frequencies. Both lie inside the existing -4500..7500 Hz alignment-noise band and24kHz complex sample Nyquist interval.
contract.legacy: A/M continue using710/1900Hz. Q is a measurement arm, including with correction bypassed; it does not key RF or invalidate a matching PA model.
contract.lifetime: Existing30s arm expiry,8s/192000sample source,4s/96000sample alignment preamble, per-tone half-peak amplitudes and retirement silence retained.
contract.identity: Accepted source ID scopes the immutable spacing. Same nonce with changed spacing is replay refusal; exact repeats retain prior receipt without extending deadline or rearming. Busy/blocked requests cannot change an accepted profile.
contract.native_status: New top-level measurement_tone_control and measurement_tone_config{min_spacing_hz,max_spacing_hz,center_hz,spacing_hz,source_id}; existing measurement object remains unchanged.
contract.activity: A measurement lower tone may be zero or negative. Source activity, output silence guards, capture readiness and diagnostics use that fact; environment-only legacy positive-tone behavior remains unchanged.
contract.privileges: No ARP/capture-filter/scheduling/bootstrap privilege expansion; request remains on inherited private datagram control.
